purpose: Teach: ６つ/ミソ/外野/ヤミ/タネ/キズ/オジサン/くず

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがリンゴを６つ買って来て下さったわよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad brought home six apples for us.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact announcement. Voice opens bright with the fact itself. Slight lift of gentle pride in her father-in-law's thoughtfulness. Natural, conversational pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんがミソ汁を作って下さったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad made miso soup for us.
lines.style: Small, genuine delight in his voice. Not performed—just the natural brightness of noticing something good. Soft, clear delivery. The simple joy of a six-year-old who sees his dad's care in a warm bowl.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「外野は黙ってろ」って仰る時があるわ
lines.en: Sho, sometimes Dad says things like 'outsiders should keep quiet.'
lines.style: Dry, knowing tone. A wry half-smile in the voice—not criticizing her husband, but acknowledging his particular way of speaking. Tender underneath the observation. Slight pause before the quote, settling into it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「闇つまりヤミの世界は怖い」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me that the shadow world—the dark places—can be scary.
lines.style: Earnest and thoughtful, the way a young child repeats something important he's learned. Not worried—just solemnly sharing knowledge. Slow, deliberate pace. Respect in his voice for what Dad told him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがメロンのタネを取り除いて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad took the seeds out of the melon for us.
lines.style: Same warmth as the first line, but deeper—this is the small, invisible care. Voice gentle and tender. The detail of the removed seeds carries weight. Quiet appreciation underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに膝のキズの手当てをして頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad bandaged my scraped knee for me.
lines.style: Earnest and soft. The pride and relief of having been cared for by Dad. Voice carries quiet gratitude. No performance—just the simple fact of being looked after. Natural, unhurried.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「オジサン世代の感覚」って語って下さるわよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad sometimes shares his perspective as someone from the older generation.
lines.style: Reflective, gently affectionate. A slight smile in the voice—acknowledging her husband's way of framing his own experience. Not dismissive, but understanding. Warm, steady tempo.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「くず野菜も大事」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me that even scraps and vegetable trimmings matter and shouldn't be wasted.
lines.style: Earnest final statement, the conclusion of a day's learning. Voice carries quiet pride in what Dad has shown him. Slightly slower than normal speech—the weight of a small wisdom he's received. Gentle fadeout.
